about: Places where junk collects, read by machine.mjs. Order matters: a path claimed by an earlier rule is skipped by later ones. Fields: id, title, tier (safe | close-app | admin | owner), method (delete | vendor | recycle | uninstall | none), os (process.platform), type (paths | versions | scratch | builds | gradle | steam | uninstall | loose | bins | command), paths (%VAR%, ~, * within one segment), children + exclude + each, parents + match + keep | keepIn, names, running (regex on the process name, or cmd:<regex> on its command line), minAgeHours (newest touch inside, modified or created, must be older), ageBy ("modified" ignores creation times, for files a tool rewrites in place), requires (versions: a file that must sit in the parent), within (paths: kept only inside this folder), heldByApp (each: held while the app the folder is named after runs), minMB, vendor, lose, explain, bat. A machine's own rules go in ~/.claude/makarasty/cleanup-rules.json with the same shape.

rules.title: Scratch folders of ended Claude chats
rules.lose: the task outputs and pasted screenshots of chats that have ended; if you resume one later, they are gone (folders a handoff or hold note names are kept)

rules.title: npm download cache
rules.lose: the next npm install downloads again

rules.title: npx package cache
rules.lose: the next npx run downloads its package again

rules.title: bun package cache
rules.lose: the next bun install downloads again; node_modules stay (hard links)

rules.title: Yarn cache
rules.lose: the next yarn install downloads again

rules.title: pip cache
rules.lose: the next pip install downloads again

rules.title: uv cache
rules.lose: the next uv sync downloads again

rules.title: Go build cache
rules.lose: the next Go build is slower once

rules.title: NuGet package cache
rules.lose: the next .NET restore downloads again; on a machine without its package feed (offline, expired login) the next restore fails

rules.title: Cargo registry cache
rules.lose: the next cargo build downloads crates again; on a machine without its package feed (offline, expired login) the next restore fails

rules.title: pnpm store (unused packages)
rules.lose: nothing a project links to: pnpm store prune keeps those; without pnpm installed nothing is done

rules.title: Gradle version no project uses
rules.lose: a project outside the scanned folders that pins this version downloads it again (about 150 MB)

rules.title: Downloaded JDK archives Gradle already unpacked
rules.lose: nothing: the unpacked JDK beside it stays

rules.title: GPU shader cache
rules.lose: close your games first: each game stutters once at its next start while it rebuilds shaders; files in use stay

rules.title: Driver installer unpack folders
rules.lose: unpacked driver installers, and a driver the NVIDIA app downloaded but you never installed

rules.title: Downloaded app update
rules.lose: a staged update downloads again; held while its app runs

rules.title: Crash dumps
rules.lose: crash dumps and unsent crash reports; a developer chasing a crash may want the newest

rules.title: Node compile cache
rules.lose: the next node start is slower once; files in use stay

rules.title: Temp entries untouched for 2 days
rules.lose: nothing a running program uses; files in use stay

rules.title: Old app version beside the current one
rules.lose: rolling back to that version

rules.title: Old Claude Code CLI builds
rules.lose: nothing: the two newest builds stay, and a chat that runs an older one holds it

rules.title: Old Claude Code builds of the desktop app
rules.lose: nothing: a chat that runs one holds it

rules.title: Old VS Code build
rules.lose: nothing: bin\code names the current build

rules.title: VS Code's previous exe
rules.lose: nothing

rules.title: Old Battle.net client
rules.lose: nothing: the newest client stays

rules.title: Old GitKraken CLI builds
rules.lose: nothing

rules.title: Previous Codex runtimes
rules.lose: the rollback copy Codex keeps after an update

rules.title: Epic launcher's staged update
rules.lose: the launcher downloads its update again

rules.title: Brave cache (not site data)
rules.lose: pages load slower once; logins, history and site data stay

rules.title: Chrome cache (not site data)
rules.lose: pages load slower once; logins, history and site data stay

rules.title: Edge cache (not site data)
rules.lose: pages load slower once; logins, history and site data stay

rules.title: Discord cache
rules.lose: images load again

rules.title: VS Code caches
rules.lose: extension installers download again on update

rules.title: Notion cache
rules.lose: pages load slower once; offline pages stay

rules.title: Figma cache
rules.lose: files open slower once

rules.title: OpenWhispr cache
rules.lose: nothing you made

rules.title: FACEIT cache
rules.lose: nothing you made

rules.title: Steam's browser cache
rules.lose: store pages load slower once

rules.title: Overwolf browser cache
rules.lose: nothing you made

rules.title: Battle.net browser cache
rules.lose: the launcher loads slower once

rules.title: Build output of a project idle for 30 days
rules.lose: the next build or install of that project takes longer; its .env and other files outside these folders are not touched; a worktree whose node_modules links here breaks until it installs again

rules.title: Old Edge WebView copy
rules.explain: Removes an Edge WebView version no running program used at scan time. Close your apps before you run this. Windows asks nothing here.

rules.title: Windows crash dumps and error reports
rules.explain: Diagnostics of past crashes. Nothing you made; a support case about an old crash would want them.

rules.title: Windows Update downloads
rules.explain: Stops the update service, deletes updates that are already downloaded, starts it again. An update in progress downloads again.

rules.title: Windows Temp entries older than 2 days
rules.explain: Folders are judged by their own date here, not the newest file inside; files in use stay. ERROR: No files found only means nothing was old enough.

rules.title: Windows component store cleanup (DISM)
rules.explain: DISM runs 5 to 15 minutes with a progress bar. It removes superseded component versions; installed updates stay uninstallable.

rules.title: Delivery Optimization cache
rules.explain: Update pieces Windows keeps to share with other PCs. Nothing you made.

rules.title: Steam game
rules.lose: the game until you install it again; saves in the Steam cloud stay

rules.title: Epic game
rules.lose: uninstall it in the Epic launcher: Library, the game's ... menu, Uninstall

rules.title: Large installed program
rules.lose: the program; its uninstaller says what it keeps

rules.title: Large item in Downloads
rules.lose: it goes to the Recycle Bin while it fits; a portable app or game keeps its settings and saves inside

rules.title: Large item in Videos
rules.lose: it goes to the Recycle Bin and can be restored from there

rules.title: Loose files beside the repos
rules.lose: logs, drafts and bundles chats left; they go to the Recycle Bin

rules.title: Recycle Bin
rules.lose: empty it in Explorer when you are sure: nothing in it can be restored after

rules.title: Claude chat transcripts
rules.lose: old chats cannot be resumed and /makarasty-tools:selfreview loses its history; delete old ones by hand if at all
